why: Bold's extra bets, where Jev's info rating is 0.2–0.5, are losing $31.79 per $100 (7 bets), and main's info-stopped markets lose $70 per $100 (16). A 0.35 threshold tests where the cutoff really belongs, without collapsing bold into a copy of main.
judge_by: Bold's P&L per $100 staked since the change beats its old -$31.79 per $100, and is closer to or above main's over the same period.

why: Jev alone scores worse than the market in every category, with a Brier of 0.221 against 0.052 in crypto (21 resolved) and 0.294 against 0.168 in economy (12 resolved). The experiment is to demand a bigger edge and skip Jev's worst categories, while leaving the info gate at 0.2 so it stays distinct from Jev alone.
judge_by: On bets opened after this change, P&L per $100 staked beats its all-time -$17.4 per $100 and is at least as good as jev_alone over the same period.
